name: Night Drivin
author: Addicting Games
description: Night Drivin is a free racing game. Some people are just passengers when it comes to life, but you? You're a driver. What do you do? You drive! And what better time to drive than at night when the sun is gone and the world is only lit by the pale light of the moon and your own razor-thin headlights. In Night Drivin' you will be taking to the streets to outrace your fast and furious friends. Life can get pretty dull and the grind of a 9-5 job can wear on almost any person --during the day. But the night time is the right time for those of you who crave the adrenalin rush that is inherent in street racing and activating your turbos as you outmaneuver your opponents. Life is a race, and if you don't know how to use your turbos and overtake everyone else then you'll be stuck spinning your wheels in obscurity as the rest of the world screams their way up the leaderboard, leaving you and all your daytime dreams in the dust.
